def solve():

    d = int(input_data[3])

    # Forward pass: maximize speed from left to right
    for i in range(1, t):

    for i in range(t-2, -1, -1):
        speeds[i] = min(speeds[i], speeds[i+1] + d)

    total_distance = sum(speeds)
    print(total_distance)
